units.source_text: 只剩下大竹七段一人，他目不转睛地盯着右下角的白模样。

en.t: Only Otake 7-dan remained, staring fixedly at White's formation in the lower right corner.

units.source_text: 他思考了一小时零十三分，过了一点半，封了棋，这就是在中央黑99的刺。

en.t: He thought for one hour and thirteen minutes, and after half past one he sealed his move: Black 99's attachment in the center.
